name: ametller-origen
description: Shop and analyze Ametller Origen from Claude — catalog, online and offline history, backtested basket suggestions, and real cart changes without checkout.
long_description:
Shop and understand your Ametller Origen groceries by talking to Claude. The extension uses Ametller's commerce API to browse the catalog, read complete online purchase history, and add, change, or remove items in your real cart. An optional local Gmail workflow imports offline digital tickets.

**Key Features:**
• **Search and browse** the catalog with official images, current prices, and availability.
• **Purchase insights** — frequent products and spend by month/category across online orders and optional offline tickets.
• **Smart basket suggestions** — an honestly backtested repeat-purchase model ranks likely next products, and a Claude Desktop MCP App lets you select and explicitly approve additions.
• **Explore separately** — ask for local, seasonal, or unfamiliar products through the live catalog instead of pretending purchase history can predict something never bought.
• **Fill the real cart** — add items, set quantities, or remove them; every change is reversible.

**You stay in control of payment.** There is no checkout or payment tool, by design — Claude fills the cart and you review and pay on the Ametller Origen site. The browser is used only to establish authorization (including 2FA); it is never driven or scraped for catalog, orders, statistics, tickets, or cart operations. Sessions and synced tickets remain in private local state.

Offline ticket sync additionally requires Python 3 and an authenticated gws CLI. This extension targets Claude Desktop on macOS. It is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Ametller Origen.

tools.name: ametller_get_shopping_guide
tools.description: Return the Ametller Origen shopping playbook (how to present products, fill the cart, reorder). Read first, at the start of any Ametller task.

tools.name: ametller_auth_status
tools.description: Check whether the Ametller Origen session is valid.

tools.name: ametller_login
tools.description: Open a browser window to sign in to Ametller Origen (handling any 2FA); the session is saved so the other tools work.

tools.name: ametller_search_products
tools.description: Find products and their ids; an id is needed before adding to the cart.

tools.name: ametller_get_product
tools.description: Get details for a single product by id.

tools.name: ametller_get_cart
tools.description: Show the current real cart: items, quantities, and total.

tools.name: ametller_get_purchase_history
tools.description: List past orders with date, total, status, and item count.

tools.name: ametller_get_order_items
tools.description: List the products in a past order without adding anything (defaults to the latest order).

tools.name: ametller_sync_offline_tickets
tools.description: Refresh the private local offline-ticket cache from Ametller digital receipts in Gmail.

tools.name: ametller_get_offline_tickets
tools.description: Read privately cached offline shop tickets with optional date filters.

tools.name: ametller_purchase_insights
tools.description: Analyze online and optional offline purchases, render charts, and prepare explicitly approved, backtested repeat-purchase suggestions.

tools.name: ametller_add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the real cart by id (increments the quantity if it is already present).

tools.name: ametller_set_quantity
tools.description: Set the exact quantity of a product in the cart (0 removes it).

tools.name: ametller_remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove a product from the cart entirely.

tools.name: ametller_reorder_order
tools.description: Add all items from a past order to the cart in one step (a 'buy again'); defaults to the latest order.
